description: Header file defining the OpenH264 video decoder class for the starboard platform, including class declaration, member variables, and method signatures.

classes.name: VideoDecoder
classes.description: A class implementing a video decoder using OpenH264, supporting initialization, decoding, resetting, and retrieving decode targets.

methods.name: VideoDecoder
methods.description: Constructor for the VideoDecoder class, initializing with video codec, output mode, and graphics context provider.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with status and error callbacks.

methods.name: GetPrerollFrameCount
methods.description: Returns the number of preroll frames (fixed at 8).

methods.name: GetPrerollTimeout
methods.description: Returns the preroll timeout value (max 64-bit integer).

methods.name: WriteInputBuffers
methods.description: Feeds input buffers into the decoder.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream to the decoder.
